things.note: Shown as pale liquid filling the drawn burette tube, plus a word label 'NaOH (base)'; the liquid itself is visible as fill in a graduated tube.
Chalk-drawn graduated tube with 0 to 50 marks, stopcock and tip; recognisable without a label.
Liquid layer in a chalk-drawn conical (Erlenmeyer) flask, labelled 'acid'; the flask and its liquid are recognisable.
Chalk Erlenmeyer flask outline with liquid inside, never named in narration but carries the acid.
Only the label changes to 'acid + phenolphthalein'; no indicator drops are drawn being added to the flask.
Small grey dots falling from the burette tip into the flask; a dot stands in for a drop.
The flash where drops land is drawn as a yellow/gold ellipse, not pink; final solution is an olive/khaki tint, not faint pink. Only the on-screen words say 'pink'.
A circular timer counts 0 s to 30 s with 'must last 30 s' beside it.
Burette liquid level sits near the 20 mark with a gold line and '22.40 mL' read off the graduations.

changes.change: sodium hydroxide drips from the burette into the acid
changes.note: Dots fall from the tip into the flask from about 6.9 s on; the burette level visibly drops from 0 to about 20 over the video. Not shown during sheets 1 to 3 when it is first narrated.

changes.change: a few drops of phenolphthalein are added
changes.note: Only the label rewrites from 'acid' to 'acid + phenolphthalein'; no drops added, liquid unchanged.
Repeated drops fall in quick succession while the burette level falls; heading 'Early: add it quickly' also tells it.

changes.change: pink flashes where the drop lands
changes.note: A coloured patch appears in the liquid where drops land, but it is yellow/gold, not pink; the colour named is not the colour drawn.
The gold patch fades away (12.5 to 13 s); no swirl motion of the flask is drawn, only label 'swirl: pink fades'.
Flask never moves or swirls; only the label 'swirl: pink fades' says it.
The gold patch grows and stays longer before fading (14.2 to 15.5 s), still yellow not pink; heading 'Pink lingers: slow down' tells it.
Single drops fall with gaps between them; heading 'Drop by drop' also tells it. Pace difference from the quick phase is slight.

changes.change: solution turns a faint pink that lasts
changes.note: Whole liquid recolours to a uniform olive/khaki tint at about 19.7 to 20 s and stays; the hue is not pink.
Drops stop falling and the burette level holds still while the timer runs.
Timer ring counts 0 to 30 s while the tint stays; time is compressed (30 s in about 2 s).
A gold line marks the meniscus on the burette and '22.40 mL' appears beside it.
